remarks: Situated in the highly coveted First Neighborhood. This classic two-story home has one of the most popular floorplans in the tract. Enter thru the double door front entry to a large floor to ceiling foyer, spacious kitchen with eating area, separate dining room, large living room and oversized family room with cozy wood mantle fireplace. Newly installed concrete tile roof 2026.
